azimuth: counterClockwise — MEASURED, not inferred from the th = +dir*PI/4 sign (which the rig-lane README forbids as evidence). ShipyardIso.project() returns figures IDENTICAL to wharfIsoRig.project() to 4 dp at all 8 dirs, and wharfIsoRig is registered CounterClockwise; the shipyard therefore rides the same turntable and inherits the same convention. See VERIFICATION.md §2.
light: fixed upper-LEFT key, flat-facet, z-buffered, ordered dither, per-face uv texture, depth-edge darkening, no AA
keylineNote: ⚠️ This rig bakes the 1 px keyline #1a1c22 UNCONDITIONALLY — there is no {outline:false} gate anywhere in the source. ADR 0031 retired the keyline as a default for the world-art style, and the four iso-rig-pack families carry KEYLINE_DEFAULT = false. This family arrived AFTER that ruling with the ring hard-on, so it does not yet honour it. Recorded as measured, NOT edited: rig sources are the art director's and a fix belongs upstream (see VERIFICATION.md §5, gap G3).

sheet.note: no fixed sheet — cells size themselves from the projected bbox and the rig reports px,py per bake. Same tight-cell contract as wharfIsoRig; the measured cells and their under-cap sheet plans are in Assets/_Project/Art/Sprites/Shipyard/Iso/shipyardIsoRig.contract.json.

render: ShipyardIso.render(what, dir, opts) -> { data, w, h, px, py, wet, dep, pxPerM, mounts, hulls }; what = a site id or a part id

opts.hull: SHIPS id — re-sizes any site to any boat in the fleet
opts.tide: metres, continuous — NOT a baked state axis
opts.pxPerM: force the bake scale; sites otherwise use fitScale()
opts.hulls: bool — composite the fleet's own bakes onto the published mounts
opts.ghost: bool — x-ray the buildings (NOT an interior; see gap G1)

tiers.1: backyardSlip — a backyard, not a business

yards.displayName: [PLACEHOLDER — OWNER TO NAME] Nine Mile Creek boat yard
yards.displayNameNote: A yard presents as a COMMERCIAL BUSINESS with a local name, and the word "shipwright" never appears in-world (vision-and-pillars.md §5.3, owner 2026-08-07). This string is a deliberately ugly placeholder so it cannot ship by accident. Four PEI-commercial-style proposals are in the import PR for the owner to pick from; the pick is a display-string change only — the key and the id stay stable (ADR 0009).
yards.absorbsDoryBeatNote: Owner ruling 2026-08-09: NMC's small yard ABSORBS the dory beat — the damaged starter dory is sold from, and repaired at, this yard, superseding the 2026-07-25 "no shipwright stands in Nine Mile Creek" ruling. This is therefore the FIRST yard the player ever walks into.

yardsNote: Only the NMC yard is registered here — it is the one the owner's ruling put first and the only one this import was scoped to. East Point (working-fleet) and Finnigan's Landing (large) map cleanly onto workingYard and largeYard by tier, but registering them is a later item and is deliberately NOT done here: a catalogue key implies a placed, named business, and neither has been named.
